title: Lucille Ball hears the radio through a tooth filling

tellings.quote: And she had gotten a tooth filling or whatever and she's driving and she starts to hear the radio in her head

heard music and I turn looked down to turn off my radio and it wasn't out I turned around looked to see if there's anyone behind me and the music was getting louder and louder and louder I realized it was in my mouth
tellings.difference: Told by Lucille Ball firsthand, credits Buster Keaton, places it around World War II near a radio station in LA, and has her first think her car radio was on.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Lucille Ball hearing radio music through her tooth filling.

as_told.title: Lucille Ball hears radio through tooth filling

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells a story about Lucille Ball, the American TV comedian, linked to a source called The Telepathy Tapes. According to Michels, after she got a tooth filling she was driving one day and began hearing the radio playing inside her head. He tells it as a sign that the human body can pick up signals directly.
